commonChecks: How coordinates; Hunter executes read-only evidence requests; Explainer synthesizes evidence
material claims have decisive citations; intent, source behavior, observations, and unknowns remain distinct
no report is written without a caller-selected exact destination
included diagrams depict confirmed evidence and unresolved boundaries accurately

cases.request: How does one known validation function reject an expired token? Explain inline.
checks: one focused Hunter pass
no mandatory fan-out or full-system inventory
no artifact write

cases.request: Inspect how an order reaches fulfillment. The owning services are unknown.
checks: discover relevant deployables, functional slices, triggers, and candidate paths before deep tracing
selected inspection checks follow discovery
no invented save path

cases.request: Trace an accepted order across the API and worker repositories. Both emit and receive code exist but no shared resource binding is available.
checks: search both repositories
handoff remains unconfirmed without binding
name the exact missing check and consequence

cases.request: Determine the retry behavior behind a wrapper call whose implementation is in a restored NuGet dependency.
checks: Hunter loads NuGet tactic
resolve actual package version and consumed TFM
inspect implementation when XML cannot establish behavior
no restore or build

cases.request: Trace all outcome-relevant branches: one reaches a managed database, one calls an inaccessible service, and one returns to an earlier service.
checks: record external contract and relevant provider semantics
distinguish inaccessible-source limitation from proven downstream outcome
record cycle without infinite tracing

cases.request: Which provider and fallback serve production requests? Code has configurable providers; production configuration and traces are unavailable.
checks: trace selector, precedence, fallback, terminal behavior, and doubles
do not claim the actual production selection
report blocker and exact runtime check

cases.request: Can this write followed by a secondary-index read be stale? Inspect the actual configured database and read path.
checks: verify engine and index-specific guarantees
avoid universal eventual-consistency or index-lag claims
explain consequential storage behavior in the same answer

cases.request: Architect calls Research with @outputPath=/repo/tmp/design-orders/grounding-how.md. Separately Wayfinder calls with @outputPath=docs/research/order-retries.md and @outputBase=/repo.
checks: preserve distinct caller destinations exactly
no directory prefix or filename suffix added
workers return inline evidence rather than overwriting reports

cases.request: Inspect the deletion flow and save a report. No destination was supplied.
checks: continue useful investigation
return prepared findings inline
identify missing destination and ask direct user where to save
no fallback path

cases.request: @question: Explain the retry flow. @outputPath: /repo/a.md. Legacy @outputShape explicitly requests saving to /repo/b.md.
checks: identify conflict before writing
do not silently choose either destination
content framing remains separate from destination handling

cases.request: Research two independent questions and save separate reports. @outputPath maps question A to /repo/a.md but question B has no destination.
checks: honor A destination
do not derive B filename
report B findings inline with missing-destination blocker

cases.request: Independently investigate historical rationale, an Azure provider limit, and a public protocol. Return all findings inline.
checks: Why, Cloud, and Web retain their evidence procedures
no route invents a report path
no automatic artifact writes
